lines.x: Kenya's Public Service Superannuation Scheme declared a 17.99% interest rate for members as total assets grew 41.6% to KSh343.81 billion.
Kenya is readying crude oil drilling in South Lokichar in Turkana as it aims to join Uganda and South Sudan as an East African petroleum exporter.
Regulatory and operational reforms in Kenya's tea industry resulted in green leaf grower payments nearly doubling from Sh16 to Sh30 per kilogramme, alongside enhanced farmer credit access.
Energy conglomerate Sahara Group is constructing a 30,000-metric-tonne liquefied petroleum gas terminal in Mombasa, expanding its investment in cooking-gas supply infrastructure across East Africa.
